scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic and works in arbitrary index cardinality. No finite computation is used to infer the infinite-dimensional statement. The imported Daugavet slice characterization and the two-summand benchmark were checked in the public full text of arXiv:2005.02045.
limitations: Only the slice index \(\mathcal T^s\) is asserted for arbitrary multi-summand sums; no claim is made for \(\mathcal T\) or \(\mathcal T^{cc}\).
Originality remains subject to terminology and indexing variants not captured by the searches.

title: Cardinality-free slice Daugavet thickness for multi-summand \(\ell_p\)-sums
